title: Structure setup and geometry optimization
action: Construct initial hexagonal unit cells for monolayer CaS, monolayer CaSe, bilayer CaS (CaS/CaS), and hybrid CaS/CaSe bilayer with AB stacking. Relax the atomic positions and cell parameters using Quantum ESPRESSO with PBE functional and DFT-D2 dispersion correction.
description: Prepare initial geometries and perform DFT geometry optimization for four calcium chalcogenide systems.

title: Phonon dispersion and stability analysis
action: Using the optimized structures, compute phonon dispersion curves for CaS/CaS, CaSe/CaSe, and CaS/CaSe hybrid bilayers along high-symmetry k-paths to assess dynamical stability.
description: Determine dynamical stability of bilayer and heterostructure systems.

title: Electronic band structure and band gaps
action: For all dynamically stable systems (monolayers CaS, CaSe, bilayer CaS, hybrid CaS/CaSe), compute Kohn-Sham band structures and projected density of states; extract indirect band gaps.
description: Compute electronic band dispersions and band gaps needed for transport.

title: Compile structural and electronic results
action: Assemble lattice constants, band gaps, and dynamical stability flags from previous steps into a single JSON file.
description: JSON object with per-system keys (CaS_monolayer, CaSe_monolayer, CaS_bilayer, CaS_CaSe_hybrid) containing lattice_constant_angstrom, band_gap_eV, dynamically_stable.
output_schema: Object with system keys; each value has fields lattice_constant_angstrom (float), band_gap_eV (float|null), dynamically_stable (bool).

title: Thermoelectric transport calculation
action: Run BoltzTraP under CSTA and RBA using DFT band structures and unit-cell volumes to compute σ/τ, κ/τ, Seebeck S, and ZT for temperatures 50–1200 K (step 50 K) for all stable systems.
description: CSV with columns: System, Temperature_K, sigma_over_tau, kappa_over_tau, Seebeck_V_per_K, ZT. Covers CaS_monolayer, CaSe_monolayer, CaS_bilayer, CaS_CaSe_hybrid.
output_schema: CSV rows for each system and temperature (50-1200 K inclusive, step 50 K). Columns: System (string), Temperature_K (int), sigma_over_tau (float), kappa_over_tau (float), Seebeck_V_per_K (float), ZT (float).
